en.t: Oh, there was a terrible gale last year...

units.source_text: 她把铺好的被子茫无目的地拍了又拍，拉了又拉，看来是想岔开话题，

en.t: She aimlessly patted and tugged at the bedding she had spread out, apparently trying to change the subject,
When the wind blows hard, it is really fierce around here...

units.source_text: 沙子呼呼地，像瀑布一样喷流下来，

en.t: The sand comes roaring down like a waterfall,

units.source_text: 你稍一发愣，一晚上可堆起一丈、两丈呢……”

en.t: and if you let your attention slip for even a moment, it can pile up ten or twenty feet in a single night...
